protocol.purpose: test shared factor decoders with layer-specific coefficient heads, plus hidden-linear/SiLU MLP heads with an exact parameter-matched activation control
protocol.calibration_metric: mean highest-FP32 fixed-input adapter-delta single-step update RMS across six blocks, steps 50/100/250/500 and seeds 70/71
protocol.selection: closest absolute log(mean update / target); excludes loss, validation, FID and class agreement
protocol.correction: clip(previous multiplier * target / previous update metric, 1/16, 16)
protocol.gain_design: fixed 1/sqrt(8) throughout; independent affine r8/s16 is the update anchor

auxiliary_classifier.purpose: fixed auxiliary evaluator of generated requested-class agreement
auxiliary_classifier.retention: one frozen evaluator and its compact training records until explicitly removed

protocol.estimated_new_gpu_hours: 1.5–3 aggregate including bounded calibration, validation, diagnostics and final evaluations; startup additional
protocol.retention: compact source/configs/seeds/splits/metrics/logs/audits/plots until explicitly removed; no grids, model/evaluator weights or generated datasets
limits: Two fresh seeds and 5k steps of a 30k schedule; not longer confirmation or statistical significance.
Independent s16 versus two shared decoder groups s44 and one group s77 match whole-model parameters within 0.1%, not exactly.
Two shared decoder groups s16 is a fixed-width tying control; all adapters have independent layer-specific heads.
Hidden-linear versus SiLU MLP heads have exactly equal parameters; both add 0.56% whole-model parameters relative to the affine reference.
U/V decoders are shared, but independently generated per-layer factors cannot be reused as identical transforms.
Base blocks, AdaLN heads and gates remain independent; the produced rank stays eight.
Gradient records per adapter overlap shared decoder parameters; separate unique decoder and head groups describe ownership.
Rates are selected only on aggregate early function updates; fresh seeds/layers/later steps may drift and are not retuned.
Calibration seeds 70/71 and quality seeds 72/73 are fresh relative to previous studies.
FID uses5k images and one sampling seed; class agreement is a frozen proxy.
Fixed-probe operator norms and raw-model updates do not guarantee variance preservation or EMA quality.
No output normalization, shared nonlinear trunk, layer embeddings, new token-conditioning or structured operators are tested.
At most two claimed GPU workers including all stages; concurrent eager telemetry is not isolated speed evidence.
No weights/checkpoints and no automatic longer confirmation.

limitations: One fixed validation split; seed spread is not a confidence interval or test-set estimate.
FID uses held-out train images and finite sample counts; not published 50k-image FID.
Wrong-class loss measures sensitivity/use, not generated class accuracy.
External condition is a single class/time vector; sequence-conditioned cross-attention is not evaluated.
Concurrent throughput shares CPU/storage; matrix FLOPs omit non-matmul work and backward.
Generative evaluation time includes sampling and FID feature/statistic computation; isolated inference throughput is not measured.
Each screen has its own declared LR/initialization recipe; optimal rates are not established without bracketing.

limits: Two fresh seeds and 5k steps of a 30k schedule; not longer confirmation or statistical significance.
Independent s16 versus two shared decoder groups s44 and one group s77 match whole-model parameters within 0.1%, not exactly.
Two shared decoder groups s16 is a fixed-width tying control; all adapters have independent layer-specific heads.
Hidden-linear versus SiLU MLP heads have exactly equal parameters; both add 0.56% whole-model parameters relative to the affine reference.
U/V decoders are shared, but independently generated per-layer factors cannot be reused as identical transforms.
Base blocks, AdaLN heads and gates remain independent; the produced rank stays eight.
Gradient records per adapter overlap shared decoder parameters; separate unique decoder and head groups describe ownership.
Rates are selected only on aggregate early function updates; fresh seeds/layers/later steps may drift and are not retuned.
Calibration seeds 70/71 and quality seeds 72/73 are fresh relative to previous studies.
FID uses5k images and one sampling seed; class agreement is a frozen proxy.
Fixed-probe operator norms and raw-model updates do not guarantee variance preservation or EMA quality.
No output normalization, shared nonlinear trunk, layer embeddings, new token-conditioning or structured operators are tested.
At most two claimed GPU workers including all stages; concurrent eager telemetry is not isolated speed evidence.
No weights/checkpoints and no automatic longer confirmation.
